scope: Original Thumb instructions and exact initialized-RAM payload; JSON/libc, synthetic MAC/RNG/RTC, flash and ROM AES/base64 primitives substituted. Literal expected semantic values do not come from emulator/client. No physical calibration or full boot.
model_policy: Every selected raw cache starts at0; no physical response or thermal feedback.
Atomic strict type/size validation replaces native sequential unsafe memory behavior.
No UART device or flash/network firmware update is simulated. Timer/clock/line/report backing is per-device in-memory synthetic state reset on restart.
Metadata name is read-only; original command literal gate is time, not name.
Two names of16bytes cannot be polled; their source-backed raw numeric caches remain command-accessible, with first-hole fresh-status behavior.
